options.name: label
options.description: Chart title: visible text and the accessible name of the plot (aria-labelledby). Must not be blank.

options.name: hideLabel
options.description: Visually hide the title; it stays the accessible name.

options.name: description
options.description: Visible description below the title, also referenced by aria-describedby (text only).

options.name: summary
options.description: Replaces the generated accessible summary (stage count, first and last stage, overall conversion, largest drop).

options.name: valueFormat
options.description: Number format for stage values in labels, accessible names, the tooltip, the data table, and the summary. Conversions are always percentages with at most one fraction digit.

options.name: formatValue
options.description: Custom value text; overrides valueFormat.

options.name: hiddenSeries
options.description: Shared chart option; validated but has no effect (a funnel has no toggleable series).

options.name: stages
options.description: Stages in order: { id, label, value: number | null, color?: 1-8 }. Ids are unique and non-empty; values are non-negative; null, NaN, and infinities are a missing stage (read "No value").

options.name: color
options.description: Palette slot for every stage without its own color.

options.name: theme
options.description: Look and feel: { palette?: string[] (1-8 CSS colors for slots 1-8); fontFamily?; fontSize? (8-32 px); textColor?; gridLines?: boolean; gridColor?; gridDash? ("4 2" or "none"); axisColor?; lineWidth? (0.5-12 px); markerSize? (1-20 px); cornerRadius?, barRadius?, cellRadius?, sliceRadius?, boxRadius? (0-50 px); swatchRadius? (0-8 px); tooltipRadius?, controlRadius? (0-50 px); lineJoin?: 'round' | 'miter' | 'bevel'; areaOpacity? (0-1); gradient?: boolean; valueLabelColor?; tooltip?: { background?, color?, borderColor? }; legendPosition?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'start' | 'end'; animation?: boolean | { duration?: number (0-5000 ms) } }. Applied as --aui-chart-* custom properties and classes on the host through the CSSOM (CSP-safe); colors are validated with CSS.supports('color'). Animation is opt-in and never runs with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce or [data-aui-animation='none'].

options.name: renderTooltip
options.description: Custom tooltip content as DOM nodes (never HTML strings). context: { title, rows: { label, value, seriesId }[], column, row, source: "pointer" | "focus" | "sync" }. Return null for the default tooltip. The tooltip stays aria-hidden; the focused mark keeps its accessible label.

options.name: syncGroup
options.description: Synchronized crosshair: charts with the same group show the crosshair, highlight, and tooltip at the same column (category or x index) when one of them is hovered or focused. Focus never moves between charts. Use charts that share their categories or x values.

options.name: legend
options.description: Shared chart configuration; a funnel never shows a legend (stages are labelled beside their bars).

options.name: dataTable
options.description: Data table fallback (Stage, Value, Of first stage, Of previous stage): behind a Show data table button (built on first open), always visible, visually hidden (screen readers only), or none.

options.name: tooltip
options.description: Tooltip on pointer hover and keyboard focus (value, of first stage, of previous stage).

options.name: patterns
options.description: Shared chart configuration; toggles the aui-chart--patterns host class. Funnel stages draw no textures (there is one series).

options.name: height
options.description: Plot height in CSS px (integer 120-2000), divided evenly between stages; the width follows the container.

options.name: showConversion
options.description: Print the conversion from the previous stage next to each stage value ("400 | 40%"). Accessible names, the tooltip, and the table always include conversions.

options.name: locale
options.description: Number, percent, and message locale.

options.name: direction
options.description: rtl moves stage names and values to the right side and swaps ArrowLeft/ArrowRight.

properties.name: element
properties.description: The plot (svg role="group"), named by the title and described by the summary.

properties.name: hiddenSeries
properties.description: Always empty (a funnel has no toggleable series).

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge, validate, and re-render. Invalid options throw and keep the previous state. Keyboard focus stays on the same stage (by id).

methods.name: setSeriesVisible
methods.description: Shared chart method; re-renders but has no visible effect on a funnel. Emits no event.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, host classes, listeners, the resize observer, and the configuration subscription.

events.name: aui-point-click
events.detail: FunnelChartPointClickDetail = ChartPointClickDetail: { seriesId: string | null; column: number; row: number; label: string; series: string; value: string; source: 'pointer' | 'keyboard' }
events.description: A data mark was activated: pointer click or tap, or Enter / Space on the focused mark. label is the category, x value, or item; value is the formatted value text. Keyboard navigation is unchanged.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart
cssClasses.description: Host (shared chart chrome).

cssClasses.name: aui-funnel-chart
cssClasses.description: Host modifier for this chart type.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart--patterns
cssClasses.description: patterns option on (no textures are drawn by a funnel).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__header / __title / __title--hidden / __description / __toolbar
cssClasses.description: Title and description; the toolbar stays hidden.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__legend
cssClasses.description: Legend list; always hidden for a funnel.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__body / __svg / __layer
cssClasses.description: Plot container (height from --aui-chart-height), SVG, and drawing layer.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__series--c1 ... --c8
cssClasses.description: Palette slot classes on each stage and connector; set --aui-chart-color from color-chart-<n>.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__mark / __mark--active / __mark--hover
cssClasses.description: Focusable stage bar and its states.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__bar
cssClasses.description: Stage bar paint (series color with a surface-colored separator; text-colored outline on hover and focus).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__tick-label
cssClasses.description: Value (and conversion) text under each stage name.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__tooltip / __tooltip-title / __tooltip-rows / __tooltip-row / __tooltip-label / __tooltip-value / __swatch
cssClasses.description: Tooltip (aria-hidden; the focused stage carries the same text).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__empty
cssClasses.description: Empty state text (No data).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__summary
cssClasses.description: Hidden summary referenced by aria-describedby.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__data / __data--hidden / __table-toggle / __table-scroll / __table / __cell--numeric
cssClasses.description: Data table fallback.

cssClasses.name: aui-funnel-chart__stages / __stage
cssClasses.description: Stage bar group and one group per stage.

cssClasses.name: aui-funnel-chart__missing
cssClasses.description: Missing stage (null value): dashed outline, no fill.

cssClasses.name: aui-funnel-chart__joins / __join
cssClasses.description: Decorative (aria-hidden) trapezoid connectors between consecutive stages with values.

cssClasses.name: aui-funnel-chart__labels / __name
cssClasses.description: Stage names and values beside the funnel (aria-hidden).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart--legend-bottom / --legend-start / --legend-end
cssClasses.description: theme.legendPosition (top is the default layout).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart--no-grid / --gradient / --animate / --entering
cssClasses.description: theme.gridLines: false, theme.gradient, theme.animation (entering: the render that animates).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__annotations / __annotation-line / __annotation-band / __annotation-label / __annotation--<tone>
cssClasses.description: Annotations (aria-hidden), drawn under the marks.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__gradient / __gradient-stop
cssClasses.description: Gradient fills (theme.gradient).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__tooltip--custom
cssClasses.description: Tooltip content comes from renderTooltip.
